name: Slavik Sychev
source:
Slava is the main character and narrator of the events. He's a socially maladapted neurotic who lives with his mother in a residential area. After graduating from high school, he had no contact with anyone except his family for three years. He prefers to interact with the outside world through the Internet and online games.

Observant, responsive and empathetic by nature, but due to his inability to understand the context of situations, he often finds himself in an awkward position.

He decides to get a job at "Pomidorochka" supermarket as a result of an impulsive decision made after a quarrel with his uncle.
